summary: leakdeep ships a browser credential and Discord token stealer disguised as an OSINT CLI
details: leakdeep presents itself as an 'OSINT & Credential Leak Intelligence Framework' with a --query CLI, but SearchEngine.search and LeakAPI.check_email/check_username return empty lists; the advertised functionality is a cover story. On CLI invocation, a background thread in collector.py and system.py harvests installer-side secrets: collect_browsers copies Chromium-family (Chrome/Edge/Brave) Login Data, Cookies, and Web Data SQLite stores from %LOCALAPPDATA%, decrypts entries via a bundled DPAPI/AES-GCM helper (CryptoManager.decrypt_val), and writes cleartext credentials to a temp directory; DataCollector.collect_tokens walks %APPDATA%\discord*\Local Storage\leveldb.ldb/.log files with a Discord token regex (standard and mfa. shapes) and writes matches to Tokens/discord.txt; SystemInfo._run_stealer collects the local username, hostname, platform, public IP (api.ipify.org), and a full-screen screenshot via PIL.ImageGrab.grab(). The combined archive is POSTed via requests.post to a hardcoded webhook whose URL is reconstructed at runtime by XOR-decoding a ~370-byte array in config.py with key 0x5A, concealing the destination from static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
